object: observability: error tracking is built but off until the Sentry DSN
evidence: web #490 built the tracking; it stays off in production until the Sentry DSN is set in Vercel
why: Nothing was wired up and nothing has needed it while the only user is Don. The daily deploy-health check catches the one failure mode that mattered so far — the database being unreachable. 2026-10-16: web #490 built the tracking, but it stays off until the Sentry DSN arrives (Don's to-do); review_by moved to 11-06 (soft launch). 2026-10-23: the PM ruled the beta runs until April 2027 (what-this-is.md), so review_by moved to 2027-03-31, a month before the beta ends.
cost_if_forgotten: While tracking is off, a runtime error for a real member is invisible. Nobody is paged, nothing is logged where anyone looks, and the first signal is a person giving up and not saying why. The DATABASE_URL outage went four months unnoticed for exactly this reason.
revisit_if: ANY of: a member outside the team signs up; a bug is reported that nobody can reproduce; or 2027-03-31 passes with this still open.
